verdict.rationale: Flagright documents a Case Management module for centralizing investigations, a Case Create API, case status workflows (OPEN, IN_REVIEW, ESCALATED and others), and alert retrieval with alert statuses (OPEN, CLEARED, ESCALATED). That shows a real investigation-and-alert workflow, but the evidence never shows alert prioritization, or how users and transactions are grouped into a case. missing for 10: an alert priority/ranking capability, documented grouping of related subjects and transactions into a single investigation, hands-on or independent corroboration.
